description: Create or update an opportunity. If a matching opportunity exists (by pipeline, location, and contact), it will be updated; otherwise a new one is created.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

assignedTo.description: User ID to assign the opportunity to

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_upsert_opportunity
